Please read the following multiple-choice questions and provide the most likely correct answer based on the options given.

Question: You have just received the output from one of your Basic Assembly Language (BAL) programs, but to your dismay, theoutput is not what you had hoped for. To debug this program, your first reaction is to check the contents of your storagelocations. What procedures would you follow inthis processof debugging?

Options: 
A. Verify the input data used by the program
B. Trace the program execution step by step
C. Check the Cross Reference Table and the P/P Storage Dump
D. Check the syntax of the program
E. Recompile the program
F. Review the latest changes made to the code
G. Analyze the job control language (JCL) settings
H. Check the console log for runtime errors
I. Examine the Linkage Editor output
J. Check the logic flow of the program

Provide the correct letter choice in \boxed{X}, where X is the correct letter choice. Keep the explanation or feedback within 3 sentences.
